{{Quote|We're picking up numerous alarms from the moonbase. It appears to be some sort of military installation.|An unidentified stormtrooper captain|<ref name="CotF">''[[Champions of the Force]]''</ref>}}
The '''Kessel Correctional Facility''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] garrison located on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel's]] [[Garrison Moon|moon]].<ref name="Kessel: Hell in Space">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030501kessel|text=Kessel: Hell in Space|int=Kessel: Hell in Space}}</ref>

The base was constructed into the moon itself. It had a large [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] and a powerful communications tower, which were the only major landmarks visible on the surface. There were four upper levels which housed the docking bay, processing center, and temporary slave pens. Located five levels down were the command deck, officer's quarters, troop barracks and trustee quarters. It was destroyed when the [[Death Star prototype]] fired at the moon.<ref name="CotF" />
